history.body: Hi, I work around Perai and saw your Seberang Jaya ad. Is this location convenient for daily travel?

Seberang Jaya could be a practical location to consider for work around Perai. The project materials describe connections toward the Butterworth and wider mainland urban network, though I can’t promise a commute time without knowing your exact workplace and traffic. Which part of Perai do you work in?
Just within Perai, I don’t want to share a more exact spot. I’m mainly trying to see if daily errands are convenient from there.

That’s a sensible thing to check. Pearl Residences is in established Seberang Jaya, and the project materials describe connections toward Sunway Carnival Mall and Chai Leng Park—useful destinations to consider for everyday errands as well as your commute to Perai. I can’t promise exact travel times, but visiting would let you judge the surroundings and routes for yourself if you’d like.
Those sound handy for errands. I’d be open to arranging a visit and checking the area out. Could you also share the usual monthly ownership costs?

For the 900 sq ft Type A, the maintenance fee is about RM162/month, including the sinking fund (RM0.18 per sq ft). That’s the building maintenance charge; utilities and any home-loan instalment are separate. Since you’re checking both the commute and everyday errands, a visit could help you judge the area for yourself. Would you like me to have a salesperson contact you to help arrange one?
Yes, please have a salesperson contact me to arrange a visit. RM162 for maintenance sounds manageable, and I understand utilities and the loan are separate.
Sure — I’ll have a salesperson contact you to arrange a visit so you can check the area and routes for yourself. The visit isn’t booked yet; they’ll follow up to coordinate the details.
